At first glance, one might mistake Samantha for an innocent schoolgirl or the girl next door. However, beneath her wholesome exterior lies a deeply disturbed mind. Her early life was marked by unspeakable horrors that began when she was just eight years old. Her father, a violent alcoholic, subjected her to regular beatings and brutal sexual assaults. Her mother often joined in the abuse, leaving Samantha feeling isolated and helpless.
